name: PM-KISAN
who: Small and marginal farmer families owning cultivable land. Not for income-tax payers or institutional landholders.
benefit: Rs 6,000 per year in three installments, paid to the bank account.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
who: Eligible low-income families listed in the SECC database; all citizens aged 70+ are also covered.
benefit: Health insurance cover up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for hospital treatment.

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
who: Women from poor households without an LPG connection.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
who: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 with a bank account, mainly unorganised-sector workers. Income-tax payers are not eligible.
benefit: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 after age 60.

name: PM Awas Yojana
who: Families without a pucca house, with income limits that depend on the category (urban or rural).
benefit: Financial help to build or buy a house.

name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana
who: Any Indian citizen aged 10+ without a bank account.
benefit: Zero-balance bank account, RuPay debit card and accident insurance.

name: National Scholarship Portal
who: School and college students; eligibility depends on the specific scholarship (income, category, marks).
benefit: Scholarships from central and state governments.
